YouTube Thumbnail Downloader

Paste any YouTube link or video ID to preview every available thumbnail size and download the one you need in a single click.

Downloads public video thumbnails only. Thumbnails are fetched straight from YouTube's image servers — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste a YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, Shorts, embed or live link) or just the 11-character video ID.
  2. Click "Get Thumbnails" to load every available thumbnail size for that video.
  3. Preview each size — sizes that do not exist are hidden automatically.
  4. Click Download on any size to save it to your device.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which YouTube links are supported?

Standard watch URLs, youtu.be short links, /shorts/, /embed/ and /live/ links all work, and so does pasting the raw 11-character video ID.

Why is the HD (maxresdefault) thumbnail missing for some videos?

YouTube only generates the extra-large 1280x720 thumbnail for videos uploaded in HD. If it does not exist, this tool hides it instead of showing a broken image.

Can I download thumbnails from private videos?

No. Only thumbnails of public videos (and unlisted ones, if you know the link) can be fetched. Private or deleted videos return nothing.
